about_short_description.short_description: comma is solving self driving cars while delivering shippable intermediaries: openpilot and the comma two.

product.name: openpilot
product.description: An open-source driver-assistance system that provides adaptive cruise control, automated lane centering, and lane-change assistance on compatible vehicles.

product.name: comma four
product.description: A windshield-mounted automotive computer that runs openpilot and provides camera-based driver assistance, including lane centering, adaptive cruise control, and lane changing.

product.name: comma connect
product.description: A web-based dashboard and companion service for managing openpilot drives, reviewing recordings and routes, and accessing connected vehicle features.

product.name: comma prime
product.description: An optional subscription for comma connect that provides cellular connectivity, cloud storage for drive videos, live vehicle tracking, remote snapshots, and other connected-device features.

product.name: Custom car ports
product.description: A vehicle-integration service that adds openpilot support for a specified car make and model, including required interface hardware and a working comma four installation.

product.name: commacare
product.description: An optional warranty-extension service that adds up to one year of coverage to a comma four’s standard one-year hardware warranty.
